principle: Exact metric names and units must be resolved from the installed NCU query/export used by node109; the consumer must not invent aliases.

consumer_must_verify: resolved metric name exists in raw producer availability evidence
unit exactly matches the raw export
semantic category is approved before aggregation
unknown or unsupported metrics fail closed

normalized_csv_requirements.scientific_unit: one uniquely qualified semantic module range occurrence
normalized_csv_requirements.kernel_id: must uniquely identify one logical kernel launch inside that range
normalized_csv_requirements.packed_weight_bytes: optional for RAW; required for packed-weight normalization when claimed

raw_provenance_requirement: 174-new must independently normalize from producer-preserved raw NCU export/range evidence, or independently verify every normalized row against that raw evidence. Producer-authored semantic labels alone are not sufficient.
ratios: Cross-point ratios require identical units; zero denominator is reported UNDEFINED_ZERO_DENOMINATOR, never inf/NaN.
